51b the prefix widens to a /48, which buckets unrelated customers of one ISP together
51c the prefix narrows to a /80, which is still free for the caller to vary
51f the bracket/port form is no longer recognised, so it gets a second allowance
51g hextet normalisation is dropped, so 0db8 and db8 become two buckets
